prose: Stratechery reports that Salesforce is abandoning UI as a moat with AI Force, and calls it a very smart move - because UI is disappearing for everyone. The episode frames agents as the new UI and the resulting race to headless software.
highlights: Salesforce abandoning UI as a moat with AI Force
Stratechery: a very smart move, because UI is disappearing for everyone
Agents as UI; the race to headless
